edition.title: NPNF Second Series, Volume III: Theodoret, Jerome, Gennadius, Rufinus

alternate_titles: Theodoret, Jerome, Gennadius, Rufinus: Historical Writings
work.author: Philip Schaff and Henry Wace
work.description: The third volume of the second series of the Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers translation anthology, containing Theodoret's ecclesiastical history and the historical and biographical writings of Jerome, Gennadius, and Rufinus in English. Its container identity remains distinct from the works and translated editions printed within it.
work.title: A Select Library of Nicene and Post-Nicene Fathers, Second Series, Volume III
